runtime_path.live_weight_binding: kv_b_proj and o_proj are admitted together and cloned from the existing bounded GPU weight cache. Both must be PQ; compact kv_b must be D32/S1/sub32/card256/bits8 with exact row/column geometry.

arithmetic.k_transpose: Compensated f32 accumulation in ascending key-row order.
arithmetic.ranked_attention: Compensated content/RoPE dots, softmax total, and weighted-latent accumulation in stable DSA rank order; precise exp/divide.
arithmetic.v_projection: One SIMD group per output using the same lane/chunk FMA and simd_sum order as generic gravity_pq_matvec.
arithmetic.v_projection_supersedes: HAWKING_PQ_V_ROWS_CANDIDATE_20260727.json described the earlier one-thread ascending reduction. That receipt remains historical; the live candidate uses the aligned SIMD reduction recorded here.
arithmetic.reason: The one-token complete-token fixture isolates V reconstruction. SIMD alignment made compact and expanded one-token logits identical and brought every canonical V2.1 gate inside bounds.

ownership_recovery.expanded_owner: Allocates every next-layer K/V buffer before swapping the vector.
ownership_recovery.compact_owner: Allocates every next-layer latent/RoPE buffer before swapping the vector.
ownership_recovery.dsa_owner: Grows independently and transactionally from attention state.
ownership_recovery.retry_invariant: If attention growth succeeds and DSA growth fails, a retry rechecks DSA capacity and repairs it instead of returning early from attention capacity.
ownership_recovery.authoritative_seq_len: ResidentSession::seq_len; compact state no longer carries a second logical length.
